lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaCeN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—Na₂Ce₂N₂—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce and Na each adopt octahedral environments with six N neighbors, while N is coordinated by three Ce and three Na neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Na octahedra, edge-sharing between like Ce–Ce and Na–Na octahedra, and a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph.
